children.child_text: Asterion Relay Console completed its scheduled thermal inspection under the current maintenance cycle.
The console retained its calibration seal.

cases.parent_text: The dual obligations for the Asterion Relay Console are that Asterion Relay Console completed its scheduled thermal inspection and that the console retained its calibration seal.

children.child_text: Helix Orchard Controller has its firmware audit recorded following the designated review procedure.
Its emergency override was tested.

cases.parent_text: The Helix Orchard Controller must have its firmware audit recorded and its emergency override tested.

children.child_text: Brindle Survey Beacon completed the coastal synchronization check after the designated observation interval.
The beacon's enclosure remained sealed.

cases.parent_text: The two obligations for the Brindle Survey Beacon are that Brindle Survey Beacon completed the coastal synchronization check and that the beacon's enclosure remained sealed.

children.child_text: Quenby Transit Monitor underwent the route-data review specified for the operating period.
The monitor preserved its inspection mark.

cases.parent_text: The requirements for the Quenby Transit Monitor are that Quenby Transit Monitor underwent its route-data review and that the monitor preserved its inspection mark.

children.child_text: Kestrel Array relay Rho-3 confirms that a calibration event occurred on 2031-04-12.
Kestrel Array controller Sigma-8 is enrolled in the municipal equipment register.

cases.parent_text: Both of the following statements about the Kestrel Array must hold: the array's relay confirms a calibration event, and the array's controller is enrolled in the municipal register.

children.child_text: Oriole Transit Grid beacon Lumen-5 reports completion of the quarterly inspection.
Oriole Transit Grid gate unit Nadir-2 holds an active operating certificate.
children.subject_anchor: Oriole Transit Grid gate unit Nadir-2

cases.parent_text: The two propositions below jointly describe the required state of the Oriole Transit Grid: its beacon reports an inspection completion, and its gate unit holds an active operating certificate.

children.child_text: Bramble Water Network pressure node Vela-7 records a pressure measurement of 4.8 bar during the morning test.
children.subject_anchor: Bramble Water Network pressure node Vela-7

children.child_text: Bramble Water Network treatment module Cinder-4 has a signed compliance declaration for the current operating period.
children.subject_anchor: Bramble Water Network treatment module Cinder-4

cases.parent_text: The following pair of statements must both be satisfied for the Bramble Water Network: the pressure node records a threshold measurement, and the treatment module has a signed compliance declaration.

children.child_text: Halcyon Storage Cluster cold-store monitor Aster-9 documents a temperature excursion on 2032-09-03.
children.subject_anchor: Halcyon Storage Cluster cold-store monitor Aster-9

children.subject_anchor: Halcyon Storage Cluster access service Quill-6

cases.parent_text: Both statements are required for the Halcyon Storage Cluster: the cold-store monitor documents a temperature excursion, and the access service is listed in the authorized-services registry.

children.child_text: completed its scheduled calibration in April 2026
remained available for service throughout May 2026

cases.parent_text: For Meridian Relay K8, both of the following statements hold: it completed its scheduled calibration in April 2026, and it remained available for service throughout May 2026.

children.child_text: entered supervised operation on 7 June 2026
Copper Finch Array R3 remained below the specified temperature threshold during that operation

cases.parent_text: The two propositions about Copper Finch Array R3 are jointly asserted: it entered supervised operation on 7 June 2026, and its temperature remained below the specified threshold during that operation.

children.child_text: was registered for the northern test range
transmitted an authenticated status report at the end of the trial

cases.parent_text: With respect to Obsidian Gate M4, both conditions apply: it was registered for the northern test range, and it transmitted an authenticated status report at the end of the trial.

children.child_text: was inspected after the west-sector incident
Saffron Beacon T11 received a replacement power module before the next deployment

cases.parent_text: Both claims concern Saffron Beacon T11: it was inspected after the west-sector incident, and Saffron Beacon T11 received a replacement power module before the next deployment.

children.child_text: Module Zeta-31 satisfies the specified thermal-safety standard.
Module Zeta-31 underwent a documented calibration inspection during the spring service cycle.

cases.parent_text: Module Zeta-31 is the subject of two independent propositions: it satisfies the specified thermal-safety standard, and it underwent a documented calibration inspection during the spring service cycle.

children.child_text: has an active equipment registration.
has a measured signal latency below 14 milliseconds.

cases.parent_text: Orion Mesh Node Q-58 is the system under consideration: it has an active equipment registration, and its measured signal latency is below 14 milliseconds.

children.child_text: Turbine Array Rho-204 had a recorded output of 8.4 megawatts.
Turbine Array Rho-204 experienced an emergency shutdown after a coolant-pressure excursion.

cases.parent_text: Turbine Array Rho-204 is assessed on two separate points: its recorded output reached 8.4 megawatts, and an emergency shutdown occurred after a coolant-pressure excursion.

children.child_text: was certified for archival preservation by the facility assessor.
has an active registration in the regional infrastructure directory.

cases.parent_text: Helix Archive Cluster K-77 is the referenced installation: it was certified for archival preservation by the facility assessor, and it has an active registration in the regional infrastructure directory.

children.child_text: Lumen Transit Hub 19 complies with the regional access standard.
Lumen Transit Hub 19 experienced a service interruption during the winter operating period.

cases.parent_text: Lumen Transit Hub 19 complies with the regional access standard and experienced a service interruption during the winter operating period.

children.child_text: Copper Finch Array 38 is registered in the coastal equipment ledger.
Copper Finch Array 38 produced a measured output above its operating baseline.

cases.parent_text: Copper Finch Array 38 is registered in the coastal equipment ledger and produced a measured output above its operating baseline.

children.child_text: Northstar Relay 62 was attributed to the Meridian Signal Group in the deployment record.
Northstar Relay 62 triggered an alert during the spring test.

cases.parent_text: Northstar Relay 62 was attributed to the Meridian Signal Group in the deployment record and triggered an alert during the spring test.

children.child_text: Silver Morrow Unit 74 received a conformity declaration for its revised design.
Silver Morrow Unit 74 has a rated capacity exceeding the installation threshold.

cases.parent_text: Silver Morrow Unit 74 received a conformity declaration for its revised design and has a rated capacity exceeding the installation threshold.

children.child_text: The Kestrel Array 41 is registered with the North Basin Operations Ledger.
The Kestrel Array 41 entered service on 14 March 2024.

cases.parent_text: The Kestrel Array 41 is registered with the North Basin Operations Ledger and entered service on 14 March 2024.

children.child_text: The Oriole Signal Node 58 was inspected by the Westhaven Safety Office.
The Oriole Signal Node 58 received a compliant rating during that inspection.

cases.parent_text: The Oriole Signal Node 58 was inspected by the Westhaven Safety Office and received a compliant rating during that inspection.

children.child_text: The Juniper Transit Hub 73 opened for public service on 2 June 2025.
It operates three passenger platforms.

cases.parent_text: The Juniper Transit Hub 73 opened for public service on 2 June 2025 and operates three passenger platforms.

children.child_text: The Solace Water Monitor 86 was calibrated by Meridian Instruments.
The Solace Water Monitor 86 recorded a flow rate of 18.6 liters per minute during the calibration check.

cases.parent_text: The Solace Water Monitor 86 was calibrated by Meridian Instruments and recorded a flow rate of 18.6 liters per minute during the calibration check.
